projects.name: cav
projects.description: A command-line interface for creating and rendering motion graphics in Cavalry.

specs.title: A production workflow for cav
specs.description: An optional workflow from brief to final render, with reviews before slow or paid steps and a user-defined file that can replace the default workflow.

changes: Reworded workflow and reference guidance without changing review gates or licensing rules.

specs.title: Production tools for cav
specs.description: Tools for storyboards, references, music analysis, sound sources, and frame-accurate review, with free local defaults and optional API providers.

changes: Replaced provider-quality slogans and audio metaphors with descriptions of the available tools.

projects.name: Agent Traffic Control
projects.description: Device leases and coordinated builds for coding agents on one machine, requested as allowlisted typed operations with no shell and no daemon. Includes a wait queue, snapshots, and crash recovery.

specs.title: Agent Traffic Control (ATC): 3.0 design spec
specs.description: Allowlisted typed operations for builds and Android and iOS devices: exit-7 validation, --force accountability, transport-safe device commands, batch DAGs with claim reuse, and build/device co-scheduling on top of TTL leases, the warm-affinity queue, snapshots, and crash recovery.

changes: Rewrote the spec for ATC 3.0: typed-op catalog, exit-7 validation, --force accountability, device transport and Windows contracts, batch DAG with claim reuse, build/device co-scheduling, and notices.
Hooks now only record session identity; removed atc guard and shell rewriting.
Clarified paired KMP leases and host identity resolution; tightened prose and responsive layout.

projects.name: Skiko frame pacing
projects.description: Display-synchronized repaint scheduling for Swing and Compose apps rendered by Skiko on JVMs.

specs.title: Skiko vsync and frame pacing
specs.description: Why Skiko paces repaints to the display, what it measures, and what it does not fix.

changes: Reworded repaint and power explanations; contained long identifiers in the review guide.

projects.name: Compose lazy layouts
projects.description: Lazy list design for content that grows at the bottom.

specs.title: LazyBottomAnchoredColumn: a lazy list for AI chat
specs.description: A proposed first-layout-item provider based on Wear Compose, plus reserved scroll range, prefix-sum geometry, and height estimates grouped by content type.

changes: Reworded anchoring and cache explanations; made mobile identifiers and diagrams readable.

projects.name: Compose text rendering
projects.description: Draw-phase animation for streamed text in Compose.

specs.title: Fading in streamed text
specs.description: A word fade that draws the full paragraph and subtracts glyph masks with decreasing opacity, without remeasuring text on each animation frame.

changes: Reworded the masking and queue explanations; identified the browser demonstration and offscreen-buffer cost.

changes: Added an executive summary, repaired fragmented prose and numbered lists, and contained code and matrices on narrow screens.
